description: [Ncloud Storage] Copy an object within Ncloud Storage (PUT /{key} with x-amz-copy-source). Optionally change the storage class (STANDARD (default): Standard Class | ONEZONE_IA: One Zone-IA (Infrequent Access) Class | DEEP_ARCHIVE: Archive Class) — copying an object onto itself with a new class is how an existing object's class is changed. Source objects up to 5 GB; larger ones need ncloud_ncs_upload_part_copy. A DEEP_ARCHIVE source must be restored first.

contentType.description: Content-Type for the copy (applied with metadataDirective=REPLACE)

copySource.description: Source object as {sourceBucket}/{sourceKey} (a leading slash is tolerated)

copySourceVersionId.description: Version ID of the source object to copy (versioning-enabled buckets)

metadataDirective.description: COPY (default) keeps the source metadata; REPLACE uses the headers given in this request (contentType)

objectLockLegalHold.description: x-amz-object-lock-legal-hold for the copy — ON | OFF

serverSideEncryption.description: x-amz-server-side-encryption for the copy — AES256 | aws:kms

storageClass.description: x-amz-storage-class for the copy — STANDARD (default): Standard Class | ONEZONE_IA: One Zone-IA (Infrequent Access) Class | DEEP_ARCHIVE: Archive Class. Omit to use STANDARD

name: ncloud_ncs_copy_object
